action.command: echo "=== PLS openapi paths ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:18000/openapi.json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(Object.keys(j.paths).slice(0,25).join("\n"))})' 2>&1 | head -30
